Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Authenticates the Firm and establishes the FIX session. Must be the first message sent by the Firm. Standard FIX 4.2 session messages (Heartbeat, Test Request, Resend Request, Reject, Sequence Reset, Logout) are supported.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds. The same value must be used by both sides.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Submits a single options order. Order types are distinguished by attributes present in the message.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer Id defined by the Firm. Up to 10 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order identifier, unique within a trading day per Firm Mnemonic. Free-form string up to 30 characters.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Option trading symbol (up to 3 characters pre-symbology, 5 characters post-symbology).

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: YYYYMM. Post-symbology: required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: DD. Post-symbology: required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD. Post-symbology: required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 Put, 1 Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of order creation (UTC).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts. CashOrderQty not allowed.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is 2 (Limit) or 4 (Stop Limit). Up to 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is 3 (Stop) or 4 (Stop Limit).

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If sent, must be 2 (Automated execution order, public, Broker intervention OK). Optional; assumed 2.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Required if order is AON. G All or None; f ISO. Only one value. If ISO, TimeInForce is converted to IOC (rejected if OPG).

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Routing handling to away exchanges. SRCH (default), FIND, DNR. Applies only to non-contingency orders.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 DAY, 1 GTC, 2 OPG, 3 IOC. Other values are rejected.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Order origin type. See Appendix B for OCC clearing mapping and legacy values 3, 9.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the off-floor market maker.

Field.Name: CoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: 0 Covered, 1 Uncovered.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O Open, C Close.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA number of sender. Required for CustomerOrFirm 9 and off-floor market maker orders.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (multi-account), up to 5 characters (OCC receives first 4). Required for off-floor market maker orders.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Required for PHLX Market Maker and PHLX Market Maker with CMTA.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: PHLX-XL internal firm identifier of the Directed Participant for Directed Order Flow. Up to 4 characters.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional clearing data sent to OCC. PHLX-XL allows up to 13 characters used as supplementary ID.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: P PIXL Cross, S Solicitation Cross. If the auction is active the order may join it; otherwise it is cancelled.

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Numeric auction id to join. 0 (or absent) joins the ongoing auction of the specified AuctionType.

Message.Name: NewOrderList
Message.Description: PIXL Cross or Solicitation Cross. A list of exactly 2 orders (agency and initiating sides), each with its own ClOrdID. ListSeqNo (67) denotes the start of each order definition.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: P PIXL Cross, S Solicitation Cross.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: No Worse Than order type. 1 MKT, 2 LIMIT. Required for PIXL Cross; invalid (rejected) for Solicitation Cross.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: NWT limit price. Required for PIXL Cross if NWTOrdType is 2; invalid for Solicitation Cross.

Field.Name: CrossSurrender
Field.Description: Y surrenders the agency order to other participants. When Y, NWTOrdType and NWTPrice must be omitted. Default Do Not Surrender.

Field.Name: NoOrders
Field.Description: Number of orders in the list. Always 2.

Field.Name: ListSeqNo
Field.Description: Order number within the list. Denotes the start of each order definition.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Per-side, unique within a trading day per Firm Mnemonic. Up to 30 characters.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Party represented by the given side.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol (5 characters post-symbology).

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: DD. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 Put, 1 Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of order creation (UTC).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts. Solicitation Cross minimum order quantity is 500.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If sent, must be 2. Optional; assumed 2.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 DAY, 1 GTC, 3 IOC. All converted to IOC before processing.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: G AON (optional on PIXL primary side, invalid on contra; required on both Solicitation sides); f ISO (optional on PIXL, invalid for Solicitation).

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer Id. Up to 10 characters.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 MKT (PIXL Cross only), 2 LIMIT. Solicitation Cross with MKT on any side is rejected.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is 2 (Limit). Must not be present otherwise.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Order origin type.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the off-floor market maker.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O Open, C Close.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA number of sender.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Required for PHLX Market Maker / Market Maker with CMTA.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Directed Participant identifier. Processed only for the agency order; ignored for the initiating order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional clearing data sent to OCC (up to 13 characters).

Message.Name: NewComplexOrder
Message.Description: Submits a complex (multi-leg) options order. NoLegs (555) precedes the Legs component block (2-6 legs).

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer Id. Up to 10 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Single ClOrdID for the entire multi-leg order. Up to 30 characters.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: MLEG.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of order creation (UTC).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of spreads.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 MKT, 2 LIMIT.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is 2. Net price of the spread: positive Debit, negative Credit, 0 Even.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Sender's capacity for the stock leg. P Principal, A Agency, R Riskless principal. Defaults to A.

Field.Name: SpecialInstruction
Field.Description: D Do not participate in auctions. Default participates. Rejected if D and AuctionType both specified.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If sent, must be 2. Optional; assumed 2.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Required if order is AON. G All or None.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 DAY, 1 GTC, 3 IOC. MM GTC orders are rejected.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Order origin type.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the off-floor market maker.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA number of sender.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Required for PHLX Market Maker / Market Maker with CMTA.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Directed Participant identifier. Up to 4 characters.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional clearing data sent to OCC (up to 13 characters).

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: P PIXL Cross, S Solicitation Cross.

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Numeric auction id to join.

Field.Name: NoLegs
Field.Description: Number of legs. 2 to 6.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Unique leg identifier; first tag in each leg component block. Up to 5 characters.

Field.Name: LegSymbol
Field.Description: Option root symbol (option leg) or underlying stock ticker (stock leg).

Field.Name: LegCFICode
Field.Description: OC Option Call, OP Option Put, ES Equity Shares.

Field.Name: LegMaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Option leg only. YYYYMM. Pre-symbology (obsolete); replaced by LegMaturityDate.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Option leg only. YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Option leg only. Strike price.

Field.Name: LegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Option leg only. O Open, C Close.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short (stock leg only), 6 Sell Short Exempt (stock leg only).

Field.Name: LegRatioQty
Field.Description: Leg ratio. Contracts for this leg = LegRatioQty * OrderQty.

Message.Name: ComplexOrderList
Message.Description: Complex (multi-leg) QCC, PIXL, or Solicitation Cross. A list of exactly 2 orders, each followed by the shared leg component block.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Q QCC Cross, P PIXL Cross, S Solicitation Cross.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: 1 MKT, 2 LIMIT. Required for PIXL Cross; invalid for Solicitation and QCC Cross.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: NWT net price (debit/credit/even). Required for PIXL if NWTOrdType is 2; invalid for Solicitation and QCC.

Field.Name: CrossSurrender
Field.Description: Y surrenders the agency order. When Y, NWTOrdType and NWTPrice must be omitted.

Field.Name: ContraStockLegSide
Field.Description: Required for PIXL/Solicitation Cross with a stock leg. Side of the initiating side's stock leg. Must be opposite of LegSide (624). 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: FromFloor
Field.Description: Required for QCC Cross. Y order sent from PHLX floor, N not. Ignored for PIXL and Solicitation.

Field.Name: StockLegShares
Field.Description: Required for QCC Cross. Number of shares of the implicit stock leg. Ignored for PIXL and Solicitation.

Field.Name: NoOrders
Field.Description: Number of orders in the list. Always 2.

Field.Name: ListSeqNo
Field.Description: Order number within the list. Denotes the start of each order definition.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Per-side, unique within a trading day per Firm Mnemonic. Up to 30 characters.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Party represented by the given side.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: MLEG.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of order creation (UTC).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of spreads.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If sent, must be 2.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 DAY, 1 GTC, 3 IOC. All converted to IOC before processing.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: G AON. PIXL: optional on primary, invalid on contra. Solicitation: required on both. QCC: optional on either.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer Id. Up to 10 characters.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 MKT (PIXL only), 2 LIMIT. Required for first order; for QCC optional on second order. Solicitation/QCC with MKT rejected.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is 2. Net price of the spread (debit/credit/even).

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Order origin type.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the off-floor market maker.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O Open, C Close.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA number of sender.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Required for PHLX Market Maker / Market Maker with CMTA.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Directed Participant identifier.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional clearing data sent to OCC.

Field.Name: NoLegs
Field.Description: Number of legs. 2 to 6.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Unique leg identifier.

Field.Name: LegSymbol
Field.Description: Option root symbol or underlying stock ticker.

Field.Name: LegCFICode
Field.Description: OC, OP, ES.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Option leg only. YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Option leg only.

Field.Name: LegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Option leg only. O Open, C Close.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: LegRatioQty
Field.Description: Leg ratio.

Field.Description: K Kill-Switch Notification.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Rejects an order cancel or cancel/replace request. SecurityType indicates single (OPT) or complex (MLEG).

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order targeted by the cancel or cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique cancel identifier. Up to 30 characters.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Assigned only when the reject reason is Too Late to Cancel; "NONE" if Unknown order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Order status after this cancel reject is applied. Absent if CxlRejReason is 1.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: 1 Order Cancel Request, 2 Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: More specific reject reason, especially when CxlRejReason is 2.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT (default) or MLEG.

Message.Name: BusinessMessageReject
Message.Description: Rejects an application-level message that passes session-level rules but cannot be rejected by other means. Deprecated.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType of the referenced message.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Business-level ID of the referenced message (ExecID for 8, ClOrdID for 9/D/AB/F).

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason for the business message reject.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Required if BusinessRejectReason is 0 (Other).

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2. Always the first field.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always the second field.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always the third field.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Sending Firm's Line ID as assigned by PHLX-XL. PHLX-XL uses PHLX on outbound messages.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: PHLX (firm to PHLX-XL). PHLX-XL uses the Firm's Line ID on outbound messages.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Required for application messages sent from the firm. Firm mnemonic of the sending party. Ignored for administrative messages.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Required for application messages going to firms. PHLX on inbound. Ignored for administrative messages.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Y when resending a message reusing a sequence number.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when the message may be a duplicate of another sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: UTC timestamp.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for re-sent messages.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always the last field of a FIX message.
